questions.prompt: Tell me a time you had problems with your technology device.
questions.sample_answer: Last week, I bought a new iPhone 12 Pro Max, one of the most expensive mobile phones recently. I dropped it, and the screen broke. I feel terrible and regret spending money on a new phone.

questions.prompt: I often help Grandma use the computer. Have you ever helped anyone?
questions.sample_answer: I often help my little brother fix errors on his laptop and sometimes help my parents search the Internet for information. It makes me happy when I can support them.

questions.prompt: Modern technology makes life easier. What’s your opinion about this?
questions.sample_answer: I agree that modern technology makes life easier. For example, robots are becoming increasingly popular, helping us save time with tasks like cleaning or cooking.
